payload.serviceDescription:
Sets up and manages Target post-purchase monitoring through product confirmation, email verification, consent, eligibility, Monitoring Pass redemption, status, alerts, stopping and revocation.
User provides purchase details, exact product confirmation, a verified email, and monitoring and email-alert consent.
Returns supported actions and next steps; paid monitoring activation requires a valid Monitoring Pass.

Issues one Nobu Monitoring Pass after a verified $0.99 OKX x402 payment for later activation of one eligible Target purchase.
User provides the payment replay; free setup separately confirms the exact product, eligibility, verified email and consent before redemption.
Returns one redeemable pass; Target verifies any lower price and makes the final adjustment decision.
